argv: $p=Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object {$_.CommandLine -match 'github_relay\.py'} | Select-Object ProcessId,Name,CommandLine; $mem=Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet64 -Descending | Select-Object -First 8 ProcessName,Id,@{N='WorkingSetMB';E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet64/1MB,1)}}; [pscustomobject]@{Relay=$p;TopMemory=$mem} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 -Compress

note: Post-restart PC Control health and bounded memory/process check
